Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (LC/MS) specifically compared the assembly of the Integrator complex using FLAG-tagged wild-type and mutant INTS13 proteins in human 293T cells and Drosophila S2 cells. While the study also includes siRNA knockdown and patient fibroblast analysis, the MS data described in the methods and results focuses on the assembly of the complex using these engineered cell lines.
